answer: That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate violet derivation per key. Because the grove nonce is published only after close, the wharf audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. The three words are derived from a 250 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
